record.body:
## Evidence

Expected R30 on the branch. The edit exists only as an uncommitted change on the primary checkout, because phase commits exclude .canon.

## Consequence

Phase merge is blocked until the finding is fixed or cleared.

## Follow-up

Commit the config.json edit on main, merge main into the phase branch, and rerun the reviewer once.

payload.basis: Expected R30 on the branch. The edit exists only as an uncommitted change on the primary checkout, because phase commits exclude .canon.
payload.claim: retire-test-sh: the phase branch still has scripts/test.sh in .canon/config.json
payload.invalidated_when: fix lands and the reviewer re-run passes, or a human clears it
